verdict.rationale: Stripe has a mature, well-documented REST API with SDKs, idempotency, versioning, webhooks, and API keys, plus explicit AI-native tooling: an official MCP server for agents to call the API, agent skills repo, AI SDK integrations, a CLI for sandbox provisioning suited to coding agents, and a dedicated agentic-commerce docs page. Probes confirm live docs (llms.txt, MCP, CLI) though a discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard paths wasn't found directly on docs.stripe.com.
